title: add jsonschema strict mode + improved error handling for response_format (OpenAI compat)
author: Maya Patel
description: Introduce a strict JSON Schema validation mode for the response_format API flag, with improved, OpenAI-compatible error messages and deterministic validation behavior. Motivation: customers rely on structured output for downstream parsers; current validation returns inconsistent or overly verbose errors that break clients and make fallbacks hard to implement. This PR: (1) Adds `response_format.strict` boolean to the public API schema and runtime handling; when true, the runtime validates outputs against the provided JSON Schema and fails generation if the model output cannot be coerced or corrected within the model retry budget. (2) Implements a concise, OpenAI-style error payload (type, message, errors[]) that surfaces path-level failures and suggested fixes (missing required fields, type mismatches, enum violations). (3) Harmonizes strict-mode behaviour across the streaming path by ensuring validators run on the final assembled output and on intermediate chunks (for early detection) without causing streaming interruption unless strict violations are confirmed. (4) Adds server-side metrics for schema_validation.{attempts,failures,auto_retries} and a new SDK-visible structured error class to help customers instrument regressions. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged (strict=false); existing `response_format` clients keep their current experience. Related: ENG-4123 (structured-output reliability), ENG-4199 (openai-compat response format). Checklist: - [x] API surface + docs update - [x] Runtime validator + retry policy - [x] OpenAI-compatible error shaping - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Observability metrics - [x] Changelog/release notes
